program.name: Mobility Volume
program.subject: Mobility & posture
program.blurb: Three long mobility sessions: hips and ankles, the spine, then shoulders and posture.
program.about: Mobility with time to reach every joint. Hip circles, shin-box and frog rocks for the hips with ankle work; spinal waves, thoracic bridges and twists for the spine; wall slides, Y raises and wrist rocks for the shoulders and posture. Each mixes flows with a control circuit. Three days rotate. Both later levels add reps.
